UDC 627.2: 624.04 : 006.76                         CED 47Reaffirmed 20221. Scope1.1 This standard (Part V) lays down functional requirements for the planning and developing of commercial ports and harbours and gives a general recommendation for the layout of the following harbour and operational facilities:a) Navigation channel,b) Harbour basin,c) Piers and wharves,d) Storage areas and sheds and storage of hazardous/obnoxious cargo,e) Open storage area,f) Other functional and operational buildings,g) Roads and port railways, andh) fire protection measures.
